resources.string: සිංහල උපසිරැසි AnantPlay වීඩියෝ මතට දමයි · Sinhala subtitles over AnantPlay videos

Reads ONLY the official AnantPlay player screen (me.champdev.weblock) to detect the title and the current subtitle line, and draws a paired Sinhala subtitle overlay on top of the video. It cannot see or interact with any other app. No data leaves the device except the movie title sent to your own Sinhala-subtitle worker.
